apache.summary: Path traversal and remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49/2.4.50.
apache.fix: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later.
Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later.

nginx.summary: 1-byte memory overwrite in resolver component leading to potential worker crash or DoS.
nginx.fix: Upgrade Nginx to 1.20.1, 1.21.0 or later, or disable DNS resolution in configuration.

php.summary: CGI argument injection vulnerability on Windows (Best-Fit character encoding).
php.fix: Upgrade to PHP 8.1.29, 8.2.20, or 8.3.8+, or avoid running PHP in CGI mode.

php.summary: Remote Code Execution in PHP-FPM with Nginx fastcgi_split_path_info.
php.fix: Upgrade PHP to 7.3.11+, 7.2.24+, or 7.1.33+ and verify fastcgi_split_path_info directive.

openssl.summary: Heartbleed memory disclosure vulnerability in OpenSSL TLS heartbeat extension.
openssl.fix: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later, or recompile with -DOPENSSL_NO_HEARTBEATS.

openssl.summary: X.509 email address buffer overflow in OpenSSL 3.0.x.

jquery.summary: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in jQuery.htmlPrefilter regex parsing.
jquery.fix: Upgrade jQuery to version 3.5.0 or later.

wordpress.summary: Multiple security issues including authorization bypass and SSRF in WordPress core.
wordpress.fix: Upgrade WordPress to the latest release (6.4.2+ or 6.5+).

django.summary: Potential DoS vulnerability in UsernameField via excessive Unicode NFKC normalization.
